standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf axioms on X: sections agreeing on the members of an open covering glue uniquely
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides existence and uniqueness of the section phi_U(s) from the compatible local images.

core_obligations: For each open U define phi_U(s) as the unique section of G(U) restricting on each U intersect U_i to the image of s under the given local map (proof lines 5320-5327); existence and uniqueness hold by the sheaf axioms since the local images agree on the pairwise overlaps, as shown by restricting to U cap U_i cap U_j and using the compatibility of the phi_i (proof lines 5332-5338). The family is a map of sheaves: for V subset U, phi_U(s) restricted to V equals phi_V(s|_V) because both restrict to the same sections on every V cap U_i (proof lines 5340-5352). Finally phi restricts to phi_i on U_i: for s in F(U cap U_i) the defining identity gives phi_{U cap U_i}(s) = (phi_i)_{U cap U_i}(s) (proof lines 5353-5363). Uniqueness of phi follows from the sheaf axiom on X since two maps agreeing on each U_i agree on the covering members.
proof_roadmap: Define phi_U(s) by the local maps and establish existence and uniqueness via the sheaf axioms (proof lines 5320-5338).
Check the restriction compatibility of the family and that phi|_{U_i} = phi_i (proof lines 5340-5363).
